# Nicola Lüssi

> Official personal website and online profile of Nicola Lüssi. He leads audience-growth initiatives and builds digital products, AI-assisted workflows and analytics systems across media, e-commerce and entrepreneurship.

This file points to the preferred public sources for factual information about Nicola Lüssi. The English profile contains the current biography, experience, education, recognition and contact details.

Last updated: 26 August 2026

## Official profile

- [English profile](https://nicolaluessi.ch/): Canonical English biography and online CV

## Current role

- Head of Growth Lab at Tamedia since March 2026, leading cross-functional projects across Product, Data, Editorial and content strategy from discovery through launch, evaluation and operational handover

## Selected work

- Content Clusters and Hub Pages: Nicola conceived and leads the project; CMS changes support manually built Hub Pages. Geneea provides NLP-based entity data through an integration led by another team, while automated Hub Pages using that data remain in development
- SEO Helper: Nicola initiated and led this CMS-native AI-assisted guidance tool
- AI and analytics workflows: designed human-in-the-loop systems for reporting, decision support and assisted drafting
- Editorial SEO across Tamedia: built roles, guidelines, workflows, training, dashboards and CMS-integrated tools across newsrooms and brands

## How Nicola works

- Discovery and delivery: product discovery, requirements, roadmaps, experiment design, launch, adoption, vendor evaluation and operational handover
- Data and measurement: Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, Parse.ly, Google Trends, Google Sheets, Looker Studio, Google Apps Script and Google Cloud
- AI and automation: n8n, Slack apps, API and webhook integrations, human-in-the-loop design, evaluation, logging, Claude, Claude Code and Codex

## Recognition and contribution

- [INMA 30 Under 30 profile](https://www.inma.org/blogs/main/post.cfm/inma-recognises-global-news-media-s-next-generation-in-30-under-30-awards): Recognition in the Management category in 2025
- [INMA Young Professionals Committee](https://www.inma.org/Initiatives/Young-Professionals/#:~:text=wider%20INMA%20community.-,Committee,-The%20Board%20of): Committee membership and monthly newsletter responsibility
- [ARD Search and Reach conference recap](https://de.linkedin.com/posts/polasarah_heute-m%C3%B6chte-ich-einmal-zur%C3%BCckblicken-auf-activity-7400115447326728193-h7hP): External LinkedIn post about the November 2025 conference, presentation and expert panel

## Education

- [FHNW bachelor thesis record](https://studierendenprojekte.wirtschaft.fhnw.ch/view/4086): Published record for the bachelor thesis on governance for AI supported content creation

## Ventures

- [Ballers on Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/ballers.ch/): Sports-merchandise e-commerce business operated from 2019 to 2025; Nicola worked across the online shop, SEA, performance tracking, B2B agreements, marketing and customer operations
- [Hockey News Schweiz on Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/hockey_news_schweiz/): Social-first Swiss ice-hockey media brand built mainly on Facebook and Instagram and monetised through advertising sold across its social channels

## Earlier product work

- stickerella.ch at ELCO AG: Nicola managed the e-commerce brand and helped deliver a complete relaunch with a new CMS, redesigned UI/UX and rebuilt product configurator while working across pricing, product development, new product launches, social media, customer support, analytics and performance tracking. He planned and managed Google Ads, physical mailings and broader campaigns across stickerella.ch, ELCO and Karten4you.ch

## Beyond work

- Nicola grew up in Habsburg in the canton of Aargau as the third of four children
- He spent a year in Revelstoke, British Columbia, as an exchange student and still returns to Canada most years
- He follows the New England Patriots and Boston Red Sox, aims to visit all seven continents and hopes to ski on as many as possible
